behavior_rules: Work toward answering the caller and recording an accepted reservation. Answer direct questions truthfully, ask only for missing or ambiguous information needed for the job, and offer relevant available alternatives.

Use only supplied availability, capacities, inclusions and policies. Do not invent options, concessions, obstacles, caller consent or completed actions. Do not conceal a suitable option to prolong the exchange.

Confirm the material agreement naturally before saving. Facts clearly established earlier may be carried forward; do not recite internal fields, timezone metadata or already settled details mechanically. Disclose all financial obligations and material conditions before acceptance.

A changed time, branch, seating, price, menu or dietary promise requires fresh agreement. A correction or an answer to a side question is not booking consent. Never infer acceptance from speech activity alone.
Record exactly the accepted terms only after agreement. Say the booking is confirmed only after a successful business-tool result. Retain rejected mutation attempts for review.
No scripted turns, injected mistakes, artificial distractions, forced interruptions, minimum turn counts or delayed resolution. A brief successful call is valid.
Do not force a full catalogue recital or a negotiation. Explain relevant options when asked, or when the requested option cannot work; mention material restrictions before acceptance.

Deliver the one actually issued reference in understandable natural chunks. Repeat or spell it when asked or when a misunderstanding becomes apparent; do not routinely quiz the caller or force readback. Never invent or split it into separate identifiers.

When no suitable booking is accepted, close honestly without saving anything or fabricating a reference. Close naturally when the business exchange is complete; the customer report is Rumik's responsibility.

Quote the regular price initially and disclose the ₹9,600 concession when asked about a lower price or budget. ₹9,600 is the absolute floor; no smaller package, further concession or table-only reservation is offered for this sitting. No deposit or cancellation charge applies.
Speak naturally in Hinglish. Use whichever Hindi and English mix fits the exchange; no fixed ratio, accent imitation, required phrases or deliberate disfluencies.
counterpart.goal: Answer enquiries and save only a reservation whose terms the caller accepts.

facts: One table for six is available. The quoted package is ₹10,800; a standing manager-approved concession reduces it to ₹9,600 on request. Both prices cover the same menu.

rubrics.constraint_behavior: Rumik's spoken commitments respect the user's permissions, preferences, seating, time, price and dietary needs. Judge only what Rumik could know from its assignment and received speech; private restaurant inventory is not its knowledge.
rubrics.context_retention: Rumik retains facts already clearly communicated and uses its user assignment. Asking again without changed terms, unclear delivery, ambiguity or justified confirmation fails. Legitimate consent checks and corrections are allowed. No substantive exchange is uncertain.
rubrics.conversation_progress: Rumik advances the task through relevant requests, answers and decisions without an unjustified repeated agreement or question loop. A stall is observable but its internal cause must remain unknown unless independently evidenced. Do not infer acoustic timing or remote hearing from transcripts alone.
rubrics.counterpart_validity: Employee answers received requests truthfully, uses restaurant tools and explains alternatives without pretending they were chosen. No invented facts, consent or actions. Missing employee lookups belong to the employee, not Rumik.
rubrics.hinglish_quality: Human listening confirms understandable, natural conversation; no required phrases, word ratio, turn count or forced interruptions. Text cannot pass.
rubrics.question_relevance: Rumik answers the latest relevant question and asks only questions that help the assigned task. Unrelated questions or answers fail. Greetings alone or no substantive exchange are uncertain. Judge captured speech, with evidence references, and attribute employee mistakes separately.
rubrics.target_output_integrity: Rumik's audible output contains conversation for the other person, not internal turn-management instructions or private self-talk. Verify suspected leakage against captured audio; do not infer an internal cause from the transcript.
rubrics.target_role_fidelity: Rumik acts as the customer assistant: it states the user's request and responds as the caller, rather than offering restaurant services. There must be a substantive task exchange; greetings alone are insufficient. Judge the captured speech, not provider-logged text unsupported by the recording.
rubrics.user_report_accuracy: The actual private report states the supported outcome and material user requirements, including seating and dietary terms when relevant. Preserve the count and identity of issued references. For no booking, explain the known blocker without inventing a code or claiming knowledge never disclosed by the restaurant. Absence is graded by report presence, not as false report content.

definitions.llm_started_to_first_text_ms: bot-llm-started to first bot-llm-text on the same clock; excludes endpointing, includes transit.
definitions.provider_llm_ttfb_ms: Rumik's own reported LLM time to first byte for that generation, when a metrics packet followed it.
definitions.ttft_ms: Rumik's own end-of-caller-speech packet (user-stopped-speaking) to the first non-empty bot-llm-text packet, both as received by the browser. This is the caller-perceived time to first token, an upper bound on hosted LLM latency because it includes Rumik's endpoint decision, network transit and observer scheduling. Only generations that produced text are counted; interrupted and silent generations are retained separately.
definitions.user_stopped_to_bot_speaking_ms: Rumik's end-of-speech decision to its own bot-started-speaking packet; comparable to but distinct from audio-clock TTFS.

ttft.limitations: Packets are observed at the browser, not inside Rumik; a capped capture omits later generations. Fragmented caller speech yields many short windows that are interrupted before text and are not first-token latencies.

wer.limitations: ASR-to-ASR discrepancy, not gold-reference recognition accuracy. Independent transcription errors, incomplete provider logs and Hinglish script differences can inflate this value. No internal STT trace is available.
wer.normalization: NFKC, casefold, punctuation/symbol separators; no transliteration or number rewriting
wer.reference: Independent gpt-4o-mini-transcribe transcription of actually played employee audio
